title: Implement pkg/testutils differential testing harness (prd001 R1-R5)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (full PRD for pkg/testutils -- DiffTest struct, RunDiffTests API, normalization hooks, file-state comparison, acceptance criteria)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component description, design decision DD2 on differential testing)
  - go.mod (module path and Go version)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct, Normalize function type, RunDiffTests entry point, comparison and divergence reporting, TimestampNormalizer, file-state comparison

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Define a DiffTest struct with fields for: Name (string, used as subtest name), Args ([]string), Stdin ([]byte, nil means EOF immediately per prd001 R1.2), Env ([]string, nil means inherit test process environment per prd001 R1.3), ExitCode (int), and Normalize (a slice of normalize functions per prd001 R4.3). Define the normalize function type as func([]byte) []byte per prd001 R1.4. Include a WorkDir field (string, empty means use a per-test temp directory per prd001 R2.5). Include a FileExpectations field for utilities whose primary output is a file per prd001 R5.1."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) that iterates the test slice and runs each DiffTest as a named subtest via t.Run (prd001 R3.6). For each test case, invoke both the Go binary and the reference binary with identical args, stdin, env, and working directory. Capture stdout, stderr, and exit code from each binary independently per prd001 R2.1-R2.2. Impose a configurable timeout on each invocation with a default of 10 seconds; fail the test with a clear timeout message if either binary exceeds it per prd001 R2.3. Produce no output during a passing test run per prd001 R2.4."
  - id: R3
    text: "Implement comparison and divergence reporting: apply the Normalize function slice in order to both binaries' stdout and stderr before comparison (prd001 R3.1). Compare normalized stdout byte-for-byte -- any difference is a test failure (prd001 R3.2). Compare normalized stderr byte-for-byte (prd001 R3.3). Compare exit codes exactly (prd001 R3.4). On divergence, report: DiffTest args, stdin content truncated to 256 bytes, reference stdout, Go stdout, reference stderr, Go stderr, and both exit codes (prd001 R3.5)."
  - id: R4
    text: "Implement normalization hook composition: the Normalize field on DiffTest is a slice of func([]byte) []byte. Each function in the slice is applied in order to the raw output bytes, producing normalized bytes for comparison. When the slice is nil or empty, no normalization is applied per prd001 R4.1, R4.3."
  - id: R5
    text: "Implement a TimestampNormalizer function matching func([]byte) []byte that replaces common strftime timestamp patterns -- syslog format ('Feb 19 12:34:56'), HH:MM:SS elapsed format, epoch with microseconds -- with a fixed placeholder string. This normalizer is used by cmd/ts differential tests to eliminate wall-clock divergence per prd001 R4.2."
  - id: R6
    text: "Implement file-state comparison for utilities whose primary output is a file (sponge, cp, mv). DiffTest.FileExpectations specifies file paths and their expected content after execution. After both binaries run, compare expected file content byte-for-byte and report divergence in the same format as stdout divergence per prd001 R5.1-R5.2."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "The primary API is RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) per prd001-testutils AC1. A cmd/ package defines a []DiffTest slice and calls RunDiffTests from a TestXxx function with no other setup."
  - id: D2
    text: "Normalize field on DiffTest is a slice of func([]byte) []byte applied in order per prd001-testutils R4.3. When nil or empty, no normalization is applied. This replaces a single-function design to support composition of multiple normalizers."
  - id: D3
    text: "Binary execution uses exec.CommandContext with context.WithTimeout. Default timeout is 10 seconds per prd001-testutils R2.3. The test fails with a clear timeout message rather than hanging the test run per prd001 AC5."
  - id: D4
    text: "Each DiffTest runs as a named subtest via t.Run using the DiffTest.Name field per prd001-testutils R3.6, so individual test case failures are identifiable in go test output."
  - id: D5
    text: "Primary source file is pkg/testutils/difftest.go, named after the primary exported type DiffTest per project convention (P7). The package name is testutils."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "DiffTest struct compiles with all fields specified in prd001-testutils R1.1-R1.4: Name, Args, Stdin, Env, ExitCode, Normalize slice, WorkDir, and FileExpectations."
  - id: AC2
    text: "RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) runs each DiffTest as a named subtest. A cmd/ package can call it from a TestXxx function with no other setup per prd001 AC1."
  - id: AC3
    text: "Each subtest executes both binaries with identical args, stdin, env, and working directory, capturing stdout, stderr, and exit code independently per prd001 R2.1-R2.2."
  - id: AC4
    text: "A timeout of 10 seconds (default) fails the test with a clear timeout message if either binary exceeds it per prd001 AC5."
  - id: AC5
    text: "Normalization functions from the Normalize slice are applied in order to both outputs before byte-for-byte comparison. A passing test run produces no output per prd001 AC2."
  - id: AC6
    text: "TimestampNormalizer replaces strftime-formatted timestamps (e.g., 'Feb 19 12:34:56') with a fixed placeholder so that ts differential tests pass despite wall-clock differences per prd001 AC3."
  - id: AC7
    text: "File-state comparison checks expected file content byte-for-byte after execution and reports divergence when the Go binary writes different content than the reference binary per prd001 AC4."
  - id: AC8
    text: "All pkg/testutils code compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint per prd001 AC6."

title: Implement cmd/ts differential tests -- prd004-ts R9, prd001-testutils R1-R3
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - cmd/ts/main.go (existing ts implementation to test)
  - pkg/testutils/difftest.go (RunDiffTests API, DiffTest struct, FileExpectation)
  - pkg/testutils/normalize.go (TimestampNormalizer, NormalizeFunc, ComposeNormalizers)
  - docs/specs/test-suites/test-rel01.0.yaml (all 12 test case definitions with inputs, normalization, expected outputs, and PRD traces)
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd004-ts.yaml (R9 differential testing requirements)
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (harness contract, AC1 usage pattern)

files:
  - path: cmd/ts/ts_test.go
    action: create
    note: "Differential tests for cmd/ts exercising all 12 test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml"

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: |
      Set up test binary discovery in TestMain. Build the Go ts binary via
      "go build -o <tmpdir>/ts ." and store the path in a package-level variable.
      Locate the reference binary via exec.LookPath("ts") (installed via
      brew install moreutils). If either binary is unavailable, skip all tests
      with t.Skip and a descriptive message. Per prd001-testutils AC1, the test
      function defines a []DiffTest slice and calls RunDiffTests(t, goBinary,
      refBinary, tests).
  - id: R2
    text: |
      Implement wall-clock timestamp test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      default_format_three_lines (stdin "line1\nline2\nline3\n", no args),
      default_format_empty_stdin (stdin "", no args),
      default_format_partial_last_line (stdin "partial" with no trailing newline, no args),
      custom_strftime_format (args ["%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"], stdin "hello\nworld\n"),
      and subsecond_format_dotS (args ["%.S"], stdin "test\n").
      All must apply TimestampNormalizer. Per prd004-ts R1.1-R1.6, R2.1-R2.4.
  - id: R3
    text: |
      Implement elapsed-mode test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      elapsed_since_start_mode (args ["-s"], stdin "a\nb\nc\n") and
      incremental_mode (args ["-i"], stdin "first\nsecond\nthird\n").
      Both must apply TimestampNormalizer for elapsed HH:MM:SS prefixes.
      Per prd004-ts R3.1-R3.2, R4.1-R4.2.
  - id: R4
    text: |
      Implement monotonic_clock_mode test case from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      args ["-m"], stdin "tick\n". Apply TimestampNormalizer.
      Per prd004-ts R5.1-R5.2.
  - id: R5
    text: |
      Implement relative-mode test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      relative_mode_syslog_timestamp (args ["-r"], stdin "Jan  1 00:00:00 boot message\n",
      apply TimestampNormalizer to replace relative age string) and
      relative_mode_no_timestamp_passthrough (args ["-r"],
      stdin "no timestamp here\n", no normalization needed).
      Per prd004-ts R6.1-R6.4.
  - id: R6
    text: |
      Implement error and mutual-exclusivity test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      incremental_and_elapsed_mutually_exclusive (args ["-i", "-s"], stdin "",
      expected non-zero exit, stderr contains "usage") and
      invalid_flag (args ["-z"], stdin "", expected non-zero exit,
      stderr contains "usage"). No normalization. Per prd004-ts R3.4, R7.2.
  - id: R7
    text: |
      Implement tz_environment_respected test case from test-rel01.0.yaml:
      args ["%H:%M:%S"], stdin "event\n", env includes "TZ=UTC".
      Apply TimestampNormalizer. Per prd004-ts R8.1.
  - id: R8
    text: |
      Apply TimestampNormalizer from pkg/testutils to all DiffTest entries whose
      output contains non-deterministic wall-clock or elapsed timestamps, using the
      Normalize field ([]NormalizeFunc). This is required by prd004-ts R9.1 to
      ensure differential tests pass despite wall-clock differences between the Go
      binary and the reference binary.

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: |
      Per prd001-testutils AC1, the test function defines a []DiffTest slice and calls
      RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) from a standard TestXxx function.
      The DiffTest struct is imported from pkg/testutils with fields Name, Args, Stdin,
      Env, Normalize, Timeout, and WorkDir per prd001-testutils R1.1-R1.4.
  - id: D2
    text: |
      Per test-rel01.0.yaml preconditions, all test cases set LC_ALL=C in the DiffTest.Env
      field. Wall-clock tests also set a fixed TZ (e.g., TZ=America/New_York) to ensure
      consistent strftime output. The tz_environment_respected test overrides with TZ=UTC.
  - id: D3
    text: |
      Per prd001-testutils R4.2 and AC3, TimestampNormalizer replaces strftime-formatted
      timestamps with the fixed placeholder "TIMESTAMP". It is passed in the
      DiffTest.Normalize slice ([]NormalizeFunc) per prd001-testutils R4.3. For tests
      with no non-deterministic output (invalid_flag, relative_mode_no_timestamp_passthrough),
      Normalize is nil.
  - id: D4
    text: |
      Build the Go binary in TestMain using exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", path, ".")
      to avoid requiring mage build to have been run. Use os.MkdirTemp for the binary
      output directory. Store goBinary and refBinary paths in package-level variables.
      Call os.Exit(m.Run()) at the end of TestMain.
  - id: D5
    text: |
      Per prd001-testutils R3.6, each DiffTest.Name must match the test case name from
      test-rel01.0.yaml (e.g., "default_format_three_lines", "elapsed_since_start_mode")
      so individual failures are identifiable in go test output via t.Run.

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: |
      go test ./cmd/ts/... passes with no failures when both ./bin/ts (or freshly built
      binary) and reference ts (brew install moreutils) are available.
  - id: AC2
    text: |
      All 12 test cases from test-rel01.0.yaml are represented as DiffTest entries:
      default_format_three_lines, default_format_empty_stdin, default_format_partial_last_line,
      custom_strftime_format, subsecond_format_dotS, elapsed_since_start_mode,
      incremental_mode, incremental_and_elapsed_mutually_exclusive, monotonic_clock_mode,
      relative_mode_syslog_timestamp, relative_mode_no_timestamp_passthrough, invalid_flag.
  - id: AC3
    text: |
      TimestampNormalizer is applied to all DiffTest entries with non-deterministic output
      (wall-clock and elapsed timestamps). Tests without timestamps (invalid_flag,
      relative_mode_no_timestamp_passthrough) have nil Normalize.
  - id: AC4
    text: |
      All DiffTest entries include LC_ALL=C in the Env field per test-rel01.0 preconditions.
  - id: AC5
    text: |
      Tests skip gracefully with t.Skip when either the Go binary cannot be built or the
      reference ts binary is not found on PATH.
  - id: AC6
    text: cmd/ts/ts_test.go compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint.
